notes.title: Sufoco is releasing now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33024181/49d514e694c5ab2156b5b855cae6a63b6b4925d5.png[/img]

[h1]Hello Wizards![/h1]


For the release version, a new and more challenging mode was added! The random rooms mode!

In this mode, if you lose, the game loads a different level to play.
Don't worry, your progress in the levels that you won will be maintained.

Enjoy and a have a magical day!

tags.feature: For the release version, a new and more challenging mode was added! The random rooms mode!

notes.title: Bug Corrections! Yes!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31640958/194e5d252afac4ad206d5aae24f59d5a6320f770.png[/img]

[h1]Hello Wizards![/h1]

For this update I bring good news.

Many of the bugs you find have been fixed:

[list]
[*] Invisible character when resetting the game
[*] Enemies that freeze
[*] Black screen
[/list]

Bugs still occur? let me know
